localizedValues.name: Group Booking - Full Circuit
localizedValues.description: 7-14 paddlers travelling together is defined as a large group. Two groups are permitted to depart daily, one group for the West Circuit and one group for the Full Circuit. Group bookings must follow a strict itinerary. The West (Half) Circuit must be completed in 3 nights (4 days) and the Full Circuit must be completed in 7 nights (8 days). Children ages 0-5 are free and are not collected in the party size count during the reservation process. There is a limit of three (3) people per vessel. A fourth person may be permitted if two of the four are small children.

The West (Half) Circuit must be completed in 3 nights (4 days) and the Full Circuit must be completed in 7 nights (8 days). Children ages 0-5 are free and are not collected in the party size count during the reservation process. There is a limit of three (3) people per vessel. A fourth person may be permitted if two of the four are small children.

localizedValues.name: Individual Booking
localizedValues.description: You must confirm if you are completing the west or full circuit before completing your reservation. Children ages 0-5 are free and are not collected in the party size count during the reservation process. There is a limit of three (3) people per vessel. A fourth person may be permitted if two of the four are small children. 1-6 paddlers travelling together is defined as an individual booking. The maximum length of stay is 14 nights and campsites along the circuit are first-come, first served.
